description: Fundraiser for Riccarton Rugby Club at Hagley Park on Sunday 14 March, 12 till 7pm. Around 400 people, families and kids welcome. Beer tent for adults, three food trucks, a bouncy castle and a DJ. We will need a couple of marquees.

sections.heading: Event overview
sections.body: Riccarton RFC Fundraiser is a family community event at Hagley Park on Sunday 14 March 2027, 12pm to 7pm, with an expected peak of 400 people including children. Beer is sold to adults from a fenced marquee under a special licence.

sections.heading: Key hazards and controls
sections.body: Inflatable bouncy castle, anchored to manufacturer specification and supervised at all times by [VOLUNTEER NAME]. Generator for food trucks, fenced and away from public areas. Alcohol served only inside the licensed area with a duty manager present.

sections.heading: Emergency response
sections.body: First aid beside the main entrance. In an evacuation, marshals direct attendees through the north and east exits to [ASSEMBLY POINT].

sections.heading: Roles and contacts
sections.body: Event manager [NAME]. Duty manager [NAME]. First aid provider [PROVIDER].

sections.heading: Bins and recycling
sections.body: Rubbish and recycling bins at the beer tent, beside each of the three food trucks and at both entrances.

sections.heading: During and after the event
sections.body: Volunteers empty bins during the event and walk the site for litter after close at 7pm. All waste leaves Hagley Park the same evening with [WASTE CONTRACTOR].

items.text: Bins provided where food and drink are sold

sections.heading: Inflatable bouncy castle
sections.body: Risk: falls, collisions and the castle lifting in wind. Controls: anchored to manufacturer specification, supervised at all times by [VOLUNTEER NAME], age and number limits posted, deflated if the wind picks up. Residual risk: low.

sections.heading: Generator and food truck cooking
sections.body: Risk: burns, fire and fuel spills. Controls: generator fenced off from the public, fire extinguisher at each food truck, gas bottles secured upright. Residual risk: low.

sections.heading: Alcohol
sections.body: Risk: intoxication and under-18s being served. Controls: sales only inside the fenced beer tent, duty manager [DUTY MANAGER NAME] on site, ID checked at the tent entrance. Residual risk: medium.

sections.heading: Crowd and lost children
sections.body: Risk: crowding at the busiest time (about 400 people) and children getting separated. Controls: marshals at both entrances, lost child point at the first aid tent. Residual risk: low.
